messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 tenant=zephyr (vpc-dedicated pool vpc-az-1-dedicated-42). Elevated tail latency on /v1/generate. Paging eng-oncall -> Maya.

Maya: ack. investigating. seeing big p95/p99 spikes; request mix is tons of tiny prompts (avg 8 tokens) but tenant override shows scheduler.max_batch_tokens=1800 from last Thursday.

Maya: hypothesis: huge max_batch_tokens + standard max_wait_ms leads to long accumulation windows for tiny requests, causing head-of-line waits. KV hit ratio also climbing.

Alex: that override rings a bellwe bumped it for throughput experiments. 1800 is fine for long-turn batches but bad for tiny-turn traffic.

Ravi: proposed quick fix: temporary tenant override reducing scheduler.max_batch_tokens to 128, lower scheduler.max_wait_ms to 40ms, and enable scheduler.preempt_small_requests=true to let small requests fast-path. Canary that change on 2 nodes.

Lindsey: sounds good. can you draft the redwoodctl command so SRE can push? want to validate in staging first.

Maya: staging command below. will run smoke afterwards.

```
redwoodctl tenant apply-override --tenant zephyr \\n  --scope pool=vpc-az-1-dedicated-42 --nodes canary:2 \\n  --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=128 \\n  --set scheduler.max_wait_ms=40 \\n  --set scheduler.preempt_small_requests=true
```

ops-bot: ACTION: overrides applied to staging (tenant=zephyr scope=vpc-az-1-dedicated-42 canary:2) change=chg-4167891280 user=Lindsey ts=4167891280

Lindsey: staging metrics: p95 dropped from 2.6s -> 320ms within 60s, tail improved. No errors surfaced.

Ravi: approve prod canary. plan: 5m canary then full pool roll. monitor p95 and p99 and KV miss rate.

Maya: pushing to prod canary subset now.

ops-bot: ACTION: overrides applied to prod canary nodes (tenant=zephyr pool=vpc-az-1-dedicated-42) change=chg-4167891345 user=Maya ts=4167891345

Maya: prod canary p95 -> 360ms, p99 trending down from 3.8s -> ~800ms. request queue length dropped.

Alex: hold for 10m, if stable roll to remaining nodes. also add a short-lived metric alert if p99 > 1s so we can abort.

Lindsey: rolling to the rest of the pool. ops-bot will annotate rollout.

ops-bot: ACTION: tenant override rolled to all nodes in pool vpc-az-1-dedicated-42 for tenant=zephyr change=chg-4167891422 user=Lindsey ts=4167891422

Ravi: after full rollout p95 settled ~340-420ms, p99 ~700ms. throughput slightly lower but within SLA. KV cache pressure reduced.

Maya: adding note: set tenant persistent override to scheduler.max_batch_tokens=256 overnight while SE discusses long-term traffic shaping with the customer. micro-optimizations can come later.

Maya: SE/product teams: zephyr's traffic is chatty (many short single-turn calls). Recommend either client-side bundling or adaptive batching that favors small-turn fast-paths. I'll attach sample config recommendations.

Alex: handing off monitoring for 2 hours. escalate if p99 > 1s. also file follow-up with customer success to coordinate config guidance.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated. SLOs restored. ticket INC-2026-3790. closed_by=Alex ts=4167891540 :white_check_mark:
